newsitem.title: USA: Washington state completes $8.5 mln bond deal.
newsitem.headline: Washington state completes $8.5 mln bond deal.

text.p: The Washington State Housing Finance Commission said on Tuesday it had successfully completed an $8.5 million tax-exempt bond issue to build homes for the elderly.

The proceeds of the bonds will be used to construct facilities that will be owned and operated by Assisted Living Concepts, a for-profit company that serves low- and moderate-income elderly in Washington and other states.
The total cost of the projects is estimated at $11.92 million, with $8.5 million coming from the bond proceeds.

The bonds were publicly sold and backed with a letter of credit by U.S. Bank of Washington. They were issued through the Housing Finance Commission's Housing for the Elderly program, which provides tax-exempt financing.
